## Publication Information

**Date:** 1886

**Imprint:** <i>MP</i>  (February 1886), 191-2

**Notes:** Signed ‘Middleage’, and the work of [Mary Eliza Bramston](../people/person_198.qmd), or less probably, her half-sister Anna Rachel Bramston.
